description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the 'Cohort' class within the OpenMRS project, verifying behaviors such as cohort construction, membership management, set operations, and active membership checks.

classes.name: CohortTest
classes.description: Test suite for the 'Cohort' class, covering various functionalities such as membership inclusion, set operations, and active status checks.

methods.name: constructorWithIntegers_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Tests if the 'Cohort' constructor correctly adds members when initialized with integer IDs.

methods.name: constructorWithPatients_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Verifies if the constructor adding patients adds their IDs to the cohort correctly.

methods.name: constructorWithCommaSeparatedIntegers_shouldAddMembersToCohort
methods.description: Checks if the cohort is correctly initialized from a comma-separated string of IDs.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedPatientIds_shouldReturnCommaSeparatedListOfPatients
methods.description: Ensures that the method returns the correct comma-separated string of patient IDs.

methods.name: union_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Verifies that union operation includes patients with voided and expired memberships.

methods.name: subtract_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Checks that subtraction retains voided and expired memberships appropriately.

methods.name: intersect_shouldContainVoidedAndExpiredMemberships
methods.description: Ensures intersection includes voided and expired memberships.

methods.name: setMemberIds_shouldSupportLargeCohorts
methods.description: Tests performance of setting member IDs for large cohorts (~100,000 members).

methods.name: contains_shouldOnlyContainNonVoidedMembersAndIgnoreActiveStatus
methods.description: Verifies that 'contains' method includes non-voided members regardless of activity status.

methods.name: contains_shouldOnlyContainNonVoidedMembers
methods.description: Checks that voided members are excluded from containment checks.

methods.name: size_shouldOnlyCountNonVoidedMembers
methods.description: Confirms that 'size' counts only non-voided members.

methods.name: hasActiveMembership_shouldFindAnActiveMemberCorrectly
methods.description: Tests detection of active memberships based on end dates and voided status.

methods.name: activeMembershipSize_shouldDetermineSizeCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies correct count of active, non-voided memberships.

methods.name: hasNoActiveMemberships_shouldReturnTrueIfNoneExists
methods.description: Checks if method correctly reports when no active memberships are present.

methods.name: hasNoActiveMemberships_shouldReturnFalseIfOneExists
methods.description: Checks if method correctly reports presence of active memberships.
